class.name: VGAAgentNode
class.brief_description: Abstract agent endpoint for a single parallel environment. Subclass this in GDScript to implement your environment logic.
class.description: Place exactly one subclass of [VGAAgentNode] inside your environment scene. [VGAMasterNode] locates it automatically and calls its methods each physics step to collect observations, retrieve rewards, and apply actions received from Python. Override [method _get_action_size] to declare the size of your action space in bytes, and [method _get_scalar_obs_size] if you need scalar observations alongside the visual ones. Together with [method _get_gpu_data_size], these are queried once before your environment enters the tree, so they must return hardcoded constants and cannot depend on anything [method Node._ready] sets up. Override the per-step callbacks to implement your environment's logic. Optionally, values your compute shaders produce can be returned without a per-environment [method RenderingDevice.buffer_get_data], whose cost grows with environment count. Override [method _get_gpu_data_size] to opt in, write via [method get_gpu_buffer_rid] and read with [method get_gpu_data].

method.name: get_gpu_buffer_rid
get_gpu_data
method.description: Returns this environment's slice of the shared GPU buffer, [method _get_gpu_data_size] bytes long. Only readable from [method _get_reward], [method _get_episode_state] and [method _collect_scalar_obs]. Calling it anywhere else pushes an error and returns an empty array, because the data is only fetched from the GPU during the exchange with Python. The data is one step old: environments dispatch their compute work in their own [method Node._physics_process], which runs after [VGAMasterNode]'s.

method.name: clear_gpu_data
method.description: Zeroes this environment's slice of the shared GPU buffer. Called automatically at the start of every reset, before [method _reset] runs, so data never carries over between episodes. Within an episode the slice is left alone, so accumulators persist across steps until you call this yourself. Invalidates [method get_gpu_data] for this environment for the rest of the step, since the value already read back no longer describes the buffer.

method.name: get_env_index
method.description: Returns the zero-based index of this environment instance, assigned by [VGAMasterNode] during startup. Use it to, for example, offset random seeds so parallel environments are not identical: [codeblock] var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.new() rng.seed = base_seed + get_env_index() [/codeblock]

method.name: _get_scalar_obs_size
method.description: Return the size in bytes of the scalar observation vector written by [method _collect_scalar_obs]. Must return a hardcoded constant. The default returns 0, which disables scalar observations entirely — [method _collect_scalar_obs] is then never called, and Python receives an empty scalar block. Override it only if your environment needs observations beyond the visual ones.

method.name: _get_action_size
method.description: You must override this. Return the size in bytes of the action vector passed to [method _apply_action]. Must return a hardcoded constant; startup fails if it returns 0.

method.name: _get_gpu_data_size
method.description: Override this only if your compute shaders write data you want back on the CPU. Return the size in bytes of this environment's slice of the shared GPU data buffer; the default returns 0, which disables the feature. Must return a hardcoded constant. This must equal the std430 array stride of the layout your compute shader declares. VGA never sees your GLSL, so it cannot check this for you — it only rejects sizes that are not a multiple of 4, which no std430 layout can have. Watch for padding: [code]struct { uint a; vec4 b; }[/code] has a stride of 32, not 20, because [code]vec4[/code] aligns to 16.

method.name: _apply_action
method.description: You must override this. Decode [param action] and apply it to the environment. Called once per physics step after Python responds with actions.

method.name: _collect_scalar_obs
method.description: Return the scalar observations for the current step as raw bytes. The length must equal [method _get_scalar_obs_size]. Only called when that returns non-zero.

method.name: _get_reward
method.description: You must override this. Return the reward earned during this step. The default returns 0.0.

method.name: _get_episode_state
method.description: You must override this. Return the current episode state: [constant TERMINATED] when the episode ends naturally (goal reached, failure, etc.), [constant TRUNCATED] when it ends artificially (time limit, out-of-bounds guard, etc.), or [constant RUNNING] otherwise. The default returns [constant RUNNING], so episodes never end. [VGAMasterNode] reads this each step and automatically resets the environment before collecting the next observation when the state is not [constant RUNNING], so [method _reset] will always be called before the next [method _collect_scalar_obs].

method.name: _reset
method.description: You must override this. Reset the environment to its initial state for a new episode. Called automatically by [VGAMasterNode] whenever [method _get_episode_state] returns a non-[constant RUNNING] value. Must also clear the episode state back to [constant RUNNING] so the next step is collected correctly.

constants.constant: The episode is ongoing. Normal operation.
The episode ended naturally: the agent reached its goal, failed, or otherwise reached a terminal state defined by the environment logic.
The episode ended artificially: a time limit expired, the agent left the valid region, or some other external condition cut the episode short.
